title: Part 7 Ba • Bộ 08: Bài báo ẩm thực, Bảng gói tiệc & Email đặt tiệc kỷ niệm
subtitle: Kết hợp thông tin phòng riêng từ bài báo, phép tính ngân sách kèm 20% phí dịch vụ trên bảng giá và yêu cầu đặt bàn.
tips: Đừng quên cộng **20% phí phục vụ (service charge)** khi kiểm tra trần ngân sách của khách hàng! Rất nhiều thí sinh chỉ nhân đơn giá × số khách mà quên 20% phụ phí ghi ở dòng chú thích cuối bảng.

passages.label: Văn bản 1 • Bài báo ẩm thực

meta.title: Chef Anton Moreau Opens Saffron Harbor on the Waterfront
meta.subtitle: Harbor Dining Magazine • August 15 • By Tessa Morales

paragraphs: Acclaimed coastal chef Anton Moreau, who previously led the kitchen at Bistro Lumière in Montreal for nine years, opened his newest restaurant, Saffron Harbor, on July 20 inside a restored brick warehouse overlooking Pier 9. Every seasonal menu showcases sustainably caught regional seafood paired with organic herbs harvested from the restaurant's rooftop garden.

In addition to its airy 80-seat main dining room, Saffron Harbor features The Compass Room—a soundproof, glass-enclosed private dining space accommodating up to 44 guests. Equipped with a built-in projection screen and unobstructed harbor views, The Compass Room has quickly become a sought-after venue for corporate milestones. Private venue bookings require at least 14 days' advance notice.

passages.label: Văn bản 2 • Bảng gói tiệc

meta.title: SAFFRON HARBOR — PRIVATE DINING & CORPORATE PACKAGES
meta.subtitle: Pier 9 Waterfront • All Packages Include Table Linens & Dedicated Servers

paragraphs: Policies: A 20% service charge is added to all private dining invoices. Custom-printed anniversary or branded menus are provided free of charge for Compass Room bookings of 30 or more guests.

rows: 5-course tasting + Wine pairing + Personal greeting by Chef Moreau
Custom gala menu + Open bar + Private patio

passages.label: Văn bản 3 • Email đặt tiệc
paragraphs: Crestline Architecture would like to host our firm's 10th anniversary dinner at Saffron Harbor on Thursday, September 25, for 36 employees and invited clients. After reading the Harbor Dining Magazine profile on Chef Moreau, our managing partners specifically requested the soundproof private room with the built-in projection screen so we can present a 10-minute firm highlight video before dinner.

Our total corporate hospitality budget has a strict ceiling of $4,200—including the mandatory 20% service charge—so please book us under the private-room package that fits within that budget. Also, we would love to include custom-printed 10th-anniversary menus at each place setting if our group qualifies.
Please confirm availability and send the deposit agreement so we can finalize well ahead of your two-week notice deadline.

Warm regards,
Riya Patel
Executive Assistant, Crestline Architecture

questions.q: According to the article, where did Chef Anton Moreau work prior to opening Saffron Harbor?
opts: At a rooftop organic farm near Pier 9
At Harbor Dining Magazine
At a seafood market in Seattle
At Bistro Lumière in Montreal
questions.exp: Văn bản 1 (đoạn 1) ghi rõ: 'who previously led the kitchen at Bistro Lumière in Montreal for nine years' → Ông từng điều hành bếp tại Bistro Lumière ở Montreal.

questions.q: In the email, the word "ceiling" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to
opts: structure
discount
upper limit
deposit
questions.exp: Trong câu 'Our total corporate hospitality budget has a strict ceiling of $4,200' (ngân sách tiếp khách có mức trần nghiêm ngặt là $4,200), 'ceiling' mang nghĩa mức giới hạn tối đa → đồng nghĩa với 'upper limit'.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT true about Crestline Architecture's planned September 25 event?
opts: Chef Moreau will make a personal greeting included in their selected package.
The reservation inquiry was submitted more than 14 days before the event.
Guests will watch a short company highlight video before eating.
The dinner will take place in a glass-enclosed soundproof room.
questions.exp: Nối chéo cả 3 văn bản: Với 36 khách và trần ngân sách $4,200 (đã gồm 20% phí dịch vụ), gói Chef's Reserve tốn 36 × $135 × 1.2 = $5,832 (vượt trần), nên công ty phải chọn gói Compass Classic ($95 × 36 × 1.2 = $4,104). Lời chào trực tiếp của bếp trưởng Moreau chỉ có ở gói Chef's Reserve → A là SAI.

questions.q: Which package meets both Crestline Architecture's room specifications and budget cap?
opts: Harbor Tasting
Compass Classic
Chef's Reserve
Full Buyout
questions.exp: Nối chéo cả 3 văn bản: (1) Văn bản 1 & 3: phòng cách âm có màn chiếu là The Compass Room (25–44 khách, loại Harbor Tasting tối đa 24 và Full Buyout). (2) Văn bản 2 & 3: 36 khách × $95 = $3,420 + 20% phí dịch vụ ($684) = $4,104 <= $4,200 trần ngân sách → Chỉ gói Compass Classic đạt đủ điều kiện.

questions.q: Why does Crestline Architecture qualify for complimentary custom-printed anniversary menus?
opts: They are paying for an open bar and private patio.
They are booking the event on a weekday evening.
They submitted their inquiry through Harbor Dining Magazine.
They are reserving The Compass Room for at least 30 guests.
questions.exp: Nối chéo cả 3 văn bản: Văn bản 2 quy định thực đơn in riêng miễn phí áp dụng cho 'Compass Room bookings of 30 or more guests'. Văn bản 1 & 3 xác nhận Crestline Architecture đặt The Compass Room cho 36 khách (>= 30).
